subject: chem
title: Atomic Structure
subtitle: Atomic Structure with core theory, reaction logic, and exam-focused application.
concept: Atomic structure explains both why elements are different and why patterns appear in the periodic table. The number of protons sets element identity, while electron arrangement controls reactivity and bonding behavior.

At AS level, the key model is a dense positive nucleus with electrons arranged in shells and subshells. This model works because measured line spectra show electrons can only occupy discrete energy levels, not any random energy.

The practical reason this topic matters is prediction. If you can move between proton number, neutron number, electron configuration, and isotope notation, you can answer many linked questions in bonding, periodicity, and energetics.
